annotation.title_clean: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.title_en: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National AI Office (NAIO), Ministry of Digital, Malaysia
annotation.summary_en: Malaysian National AI Office consultation page (10 Jul–1 Aug 2026, pre-drafting) on a proposed AI Governance Bill creating central oversight, principle-based requirements and a risk-based framework. The page links to the consultation paper and questionnaire and shows public comments on Sabah's status, interoperability with the EU AI Act, sandboxes, children's protection and ESG. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposed Bill would establish a central AI authority with sectoral leads.
Introduces principle-based national governance requirements and a risk-based regulatory framework.
Defines roles and responsibilities of AI actors across development, deployment and use.
Comments urge EU/ASEAN interoperability, protections for Sabah and indigenous data, and child protection.
Comments support an AI sandbox and incident-reporting mechanism.
